units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 42a:10">B. Mets. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>צ׳ דאורבני</he> a cot of bulrushes.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 6a:13">B. Bath. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>אבל לצ׳ דאורבני לא</he> but he has no right to put up a cot of bulrushes (and let the rain drip on the neighbor’s ground), v. <cite ref="N00578"><he>נְטַף</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Menachot 64b:8">Men. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>חדא ידא אאיגרא … אצריפה</he> one hand on a flat roof, and one on a cone-shaped roof, v. preced; Yalk. Ezra 1067.—[<cite ref="Sanhedrin 44a">Snh. 44ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="R00798"><he>צְרַף</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>צְרִיפִין</he>, <he>צְרִיפֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Sukkah 13b:3">Succ. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>הנהו צ׳ דאורבני וכ׳</he> those cone-shaped bundles of bulrushes are fit to cover the Succah, when the top knots are untied.

senses.gloss: pr. n. pl. Ts’rifa (or Ts. d’ ʿEna), in Babylonia.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 86a:4">B. Mets. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>ומשחין לצ׳ מצ׳ לעינא</he> (Ms. M. <he>מפומבדיתא לצ׳ דעינא ומצ׳ דעינא</he>).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 44a:11">Snh. 44ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>אדרת שנער</he>, <cite ref="Joshua 7:21">Josh. VII, 21</cite>) <he>סרבלא דצ׳</he> (Ms. F. <he>ס׳ צ׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 3) a cloak made in Ts. (v., however, <cite ref="R00798"><he>צְרַף</he></cite>).—3) name of an idolatrous temple (and fair) in Ashkelon.
